column3: alice: a Doom server (Odamex, Freedoom) in her namespace, on a UDP Service
NAME                 TYPE        CLUSTER-IP      EXTERNAL-IP   PORT(S)     AGE
bob: a client pod in his own namespace (a virtual screen, a recorder, a script that plays)
alice runs the server in her namespace; bob's client tries it. Nobody has agreed to anything yet
sudo edge-mesh kubectl exec doom-client -- client.sh doom.play-alice.svc.cluster.local 10666 10 bob
client bob: no server answered at doom.play-alice.svc.cluster.local:10666 in 15 s
alice invites bob: her consent alone opens nothing
party with bob: your consent is recorded; it opens once bob agrees too (the host's next tick); see: edge-mesh party list
bob            waiting for bob to accept
sudo edge-mesh kubectl exec doom-client -- client.sh doom.play-alice.svc.cluster.local 10666 10 bob
client bob: no server answered at doom.play-alice.svc.cluster.local:10666 in 15 s
party with alice: your consent is recorded; it opens once alice agrees too (the host's next tick); see: edge-mesh party list
alice's robot joins her own server first (it is in her namespace: no party needed)
sudo edge-mesh kubectl exec doom-client -- client.sh doom.play-alice.svc.cluster.local 10666 40 bob
client bob: in the game, playing 40 s
client bob: left the game after 40 s
bob leaves the party: the same client, the same server, and nobody answers again
left: the host closes the party at its next tick
